hero_title: One board a day. Best score wins.
hero_boards: Top 10 each day and top 10 each month win USDC. Your monthly score is your 10 best daily scores added up. Daily prizes take 40% of the vault, monthly prizes 60%.
hero_sub: Place three pieces, clear rows and columns, go again. Play Adventure for free, or take on the daily board that is the same for everyone.
hero_status: Adventure is open now. Ranked ticket sales open soon.
board_hint: Tap the gap to clear the row
num_tries: tries per wallet per UTC day
num_board: same board and pieces for everyone
num_winners: winners every day, plus 10 every month
modes_title: Practice for free. Compete once a day.
adventure_body: Work your way across the map at your own pace. No tickets, no prizes. Just practice and fun.
ranked_body: One board per UTC day, dealt the same way for every player. Each ticket costs 1 USDC and buys one try.
ranked_point_1: Up to 3 tries per wallet per day
fair_title: Nobody sees the pieces early. Anyone can re-check the scores.
fair_1_body: We publish a fingerprint of the day's seed, a sha256 commitment. After that the seed can't be swapped.
fair_2_body: The server deals your pieces and computes your score. Your browser never sees the next pieces early.
fair_3_body: We publish the seed and every move of every run, so anyone can replay each score with the verify script.
split_line: 70% of every ticket goes to the prize vault: 40% of it pays the daily top 10, 60% the monthly top 10.
prize_title: Top 10 every day. Top 10 every month.
prize_sub: Paid in USDC from the prize vault. Here is what happens after a period ends.
prize_2: The team has 24 hours to block a result it finds fraudulent.
prize_3: Winners claim straight from the prize program with their own wallet.
prize_4: Prizes left unclaimed for 90 days go back to the pool.
status_sales_note: The prize program goes live first.
final_sub: Warm up in Adventure while ranked gets ready.
install_ios: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install_other: Open your browser menu and choose Install app (or Add to Home screen).
